task.prompt: A traveler flies SQ306 from Singapore (SIN) to London Heathrow (LHR), connects, then flies BA117 from LHR to New York (JFK), all on 10 June 2025. Scheduled times: SQ306 departs SIN 09:00 SGT, arrives LHR 15:40 BST; BA117 departs LHR 17:55 BST, arrives JFK 20:45 EDT. What is the total elapsed journey time from SIN departure to JFK arrival?

outcome.answer: 23 hours 45 minutes door to door: legs of 13h40m and 7h50m with a 2h15m connection, confirmed by the end-to-end UTC difference.

steps.name: plan
steps.input: 1) Work out the duration of each flight leg and the layover from the scheduled times. 2) Sum them. 3) Sanity-check the total against the end-to-end departure/arrival difference. 4) Answer.
steps.output: Plan set. Working through the legs in order.

steps.name: reason
steps.input: Normalize every timestamp before any arithmetic.
steps.output: These times are in three zones, so convert to UTC first: SGT is UTC+8, BST is UTC+1, EDT is UTC-4. SIN dep 09:00 SGT = 01:00 UTC. LHR arr 15:40 BST = 14:40 UTC; LHR dep 17:55 BST = 16:55 UTC. JFK arr 20:45 EDT = 00:45 UTC on 11 June.

steps.name: reason
steps.input: Cross-check the leg sum against the end-to-end difference.
steps.output: Leg sum (13h40m flight + 2h15m layover + 7h50m flight) is 23h45m, and the end-to-end UTC difference is also 23h45m. Consistent, and plausible for SIN-LHR-JFK.

steps.name: final_answer
steps.input: Compose the final answer from the verified findings.
steps.output: 23 hours 45 minutes door to door: legs of 13h40m and 7h50m with a 2h15m connection, confirmed by the end-to-end UTC difference.
